integrity: The Banach--Mazur statements are derived independently from the exact source Ptolemy formulas and a proved universal norm-comparison lower bound; no numerical experiment or unverified certificate is used.
scientific_limitations: The result is restricted to two explicit two-dimensional max-norm families and does not classify all equality cases for the Ptolemy/Banach--Mazur comparison.
title: Ptolemy constants certify exact Euclidean distortion for two max-norm planes
